newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Glorious Sun IPO to begin on Sept 5 - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Glorious Sun IPO to begin on Sept 5 - sources.

text.p: The public offering of shares of jeans and casual wear maker Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd will be open from September 5 to 10, and trading is to begin on September 17, market sources said.

Glorious Sun plans to float 250 million new shares, or 25 percent of expanded share capital, at HK$1.60 each. About 60 percent of the issue would be placed to institutions and the remainder opened for public subscription, sources said.
The distribution of shares will be adjusted to 50/50 if the response of the public offer portion is good and the final price will be fixed by book building, sources said.
Net proceeds of about HK$375 million will be used to develop and expand the company's retail network in China, Australia and New Zealand, sources added.
Glorious Sun is scheduled to have a briefing of its flotation on Wednesday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
